title: Glacier Sprint
prompt: Glacier Sprint: race across frozen glaciers, grab heat crystals, avoid ice spikes
objective: Collect all heat crystals while sprinting across the glacier and avoiding ice spikes using WASD or the touch joystick.

title: Neon Orbital Courier
prompt: Neon Orbital Courier: pilot a hover drone around a cyber space station, collect glowing data orbs, dodge defense pylons
objective: Pilot your hover drone to collect all glowing data orbs around the cyber space station while dodging the defense pylons.

title: Desert Rover Rally
prompt: Desert Rover Rally: drive a rover across desert canyons, collect energy beacons, avoid rock obstacles
objective: Drive the rover across the desert canyons to collect all glowing energy beacons while avoiding rock obstacles.
